inputs.name: companyId
inputs.title: Company ID
inputs.description: Unique ZoomInfo identifier for a company.

inputs.name: companyName
inputs.title: Company name
inputs.description: Company name.

inputs.name: companyWebsite
inputs.title: Company website
inputs.description: Company website URL in http://www.example.com format. Accepts a comma-separated list.

inputs.name: companyTicker
inputs.title: Company ticker
inputs.description: Company stock ticker symbol.

inputs.name: companyPhone
inputs.title: Company phone
inputs.description: Phone number of the company headquarters.

inputs.name: companyFax
inputs.title: Company fax
inputs.description: Fax number of the company headquarters.

inputs.name: companyStreet
inputs.title: Company street
inputs.description: Street portion of the company's primary address.

inputs.name: companyCity
inputs.title: Company city
inputs.description: City portion of the company's primary address.

inputs.name: companyState
inputs.title: Company state
inputs.description: Company state (U.S.) or province (Canada). You can use free text state or province names (e.g., 'new hampshire'), or the two-letter common abbreviation for a U.S. state (e.g., 'nh').

inputs.name: companyZipCode
inputs.title: Company zip code
inputs.description: Zip code or postal code of the company's primary address. May only contain letters, numbers, whitespace, and the special characters ,-.

inputs.name: companyCountry
inputs.title: Company country
inputs.description: Country of the company's primary address. You can use free text or see the Country lookup endpoint for values.

inputs.name: ipAddress
inputs.title: IP address
inputs.description: IP address associated with the company. Only IPv4 addresses are supported.

inputs.description: Contact full name.

inputs.name: lastName

inputs.description: Contact last name.

inputs.name: emailAddress

inputs.description: Email address for the contact in example@example.com format.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.title: Phone
inputs.description: Contact direct or mobile phone number.

inputs.name: jobTitle
inputs.title: Job title
inputs.description: Contact title at current place of employment. May only contain letters, numbers, whitespace, and the special characters +&,./'-".

inputs.name: hashedEmail
inputs.title: Hashed email
inputs.description: Hashed email value for the contact. Allows matching via an email address with the extra security of not exposing the email. Supported hash algorithms are: MD5, SHA1, SHA256 and SHA512.

inputs.name: externalURL
inputs.title: External u r l
inputs.description: Social media URLs for the contact (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn).

inputs.name: lastUpdatedDateAfter

inputs.description: The date after which the contact's profile was last updated. Uses YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputs.name: validDateAfter
inputs.title: Valid date after
inputs.description: The date after which the contact's profile was last validated. Uses YYYY-MM-DD format.
